records.label: ByteDance Seedream 5.5
records.description: Natural-language image generation and reference-guided editing with up to ten separately scoped input images, with unedited areas kept stable across multi-turn edits. Normal image output, not the separate layer-decomposition operation.
records.negative_transport_notes: This interface has positivePrompt only. Write critical exclusions in the positive prose and retain any portable negative in package records without sending a negativePrompt field.
records.prompt_style: natural-language image direction with explicit per-reference identity, pose, wardrobe, spatial relationship and preservation clauses

basis.statement: The model-specific prompting guide structures the prompt as a brief: deliverable, subject, setting, light, lens and framing, each in its own clause, and relays the model author's recommendation to keep it under about 600 English words. Exact in-image copy is quoted line by line with a position, a type style and a color, and the brief closes on 'no other text'.
The published interface schema defines positivePrompt as text describing elements to include, 1 to 10000 characters, with up to ten reference images.

The editing guide splits an instruction into what changes and what stays: fence a single-property change with 'only', hold the object's own parts, list what stays as categories rather than descriptions, name what surface fills a removal gap, and relight a moved subject with a light direction and a contact shadow. A chained edit restates the keep list because no round sees the prompts before it.

The multi-reference guide numbers each reference by its array position in the prompt, gives every reference one role clause covering content, placement, preserved categories and light, and sends explicit width and height when the references differ in shape.

The transparent-background guide pins settings.background to transparent for a guaranteed alpha channel with PNG or WEBP output, rules out backdrop, surface and shadow in the prompt, cuts a subject out of a reference that has no alpha channel, and builds a pose series by passing the first cut-out back as the reference while keeping design, proportions, colors and line style as named categories.

records.default_aspect_ratio_behavior: Explicit width/height together, or a resolution preset, never both; without references one of them is required. A preset matches the input aspect with references and follows the prompt without them.

multi-turn editing where unedited areas must stay stable
separately prepared character pose/outfit assets for later scene assembly
transparent-background subject cut-outs and pose series that reuse the first approved cut-out as the identity reference
avoid_uses: hard pixel-preservation guarantees inferred from an instruction-only edit
carrying SDXL seed, sampler, CFG, denoising or prompt-weighting controls onto this interface

records.label: MiniMax H3 Image
records.description: Natural-language image generation and multi-reference editing with up to sixteen separately scoped input images, at 1K, 2K or 4K, or at custom dimensions up to 20 megapixels. The provider prompt optimizer rewrites the submitted prompt on every reference-guided request and on any request without explicit dimensions.
records.negative_transport_notes: This interface has positivePrompt only. Write critical exclusions in the positive prose and retain any portable negative in package records without sending a negativePrompt field.
records.prompt_style: natural-language image direction planned as purpose, layout, then details and light, with explicit per-reference identity, pose, wardrobe, spatial relationship and preservation clauses

basis.statement: The model-specific prompting guide structures the prompt as a plan of the image: purpose, layout, then details and light, with counts written as numbers and positions anchored to the frame, and documents that settings.promptOptimizer, on by default, rewrites the prompt into a detailed scene description before generation without returning the rewritten text.
The published interface schema defines positivePrompt as text describing elements to include, 1 to 32000 characters, with up to sixteen reference images.

The prompt optimizer guide restricts settings.promptOptimizer false to text-to-image requests with explicit width and height, notes that with the optimizer off the model reads only about the first 4096 tokens, and warns that copy the prompt does not quote comes back garbled with the optimizer off.

The editing guide has no mask channel: point at the target by location or by a feature nothing else in the frame shares, then fence the change with the parts that hold and a keep list of named frame contents. Every edit round re-renders and sharpens the whole image, so chains stay short and a drifted result restarts from the earliest acceptable round.

The multi-reference guide numbers each reference by its array position, gives every reference one role clause, says explicitly what may change, and scopes a color-only reference by ranked colors such as its dominant and darkest color.

The text and layouts guide quotes every exact string with a position, a relative size and its line breaks, names layout sections before their content, spells grids out as rows and columns, and notes that misspellings appear in small type first.

records.default_aspect_ratio_behavior: Explicit width/height together, or a resolution preset, never both; sizing may be omitted entirely, which the provider answers with 4K at a model-picked aspect. A preset matches the input aspect with references and follows the prompt without them.
recommended_uses: natural-language text-to-image generation
compositions merging several separately scoped reference subjects
text-heavy or layout-exact visuals such as posters and infographics
avoid_uses: identity-critical reference work where the authored prompt must reach the model verbatim; the forced prompt optimizer rewrites it
hard pixel-preservation guarantees inferred from an instruction-only edit
carrying SDXL seed, sampler, CFG, denoising or prompt-weighting controls onto this interface
long chained edit sessions; every round re-renders and sharpens the whole image, so quality drifts and the chain restarts from the earliest acceptable round
ordering: requested pose, expression and wardrobe changes

constraints.text: Final positivePrompt length 1..32000 including reference instructions; no separate negativePrompt.
constraints.controls: settings.promptOptimizer boolean; the observed schema fixes it to true whenever reference images are supplied or explicit width and height are omitted. No seed, steps, scheduler, CFGScale, strength, promptWeighting, seedImage or maskImage.
constraints.prompt_optimizer: With the optimizer on, the model author rewrites the prompt into a detailed scene description before generating; the rewritten text is not returned.
